subject.title: Feature request: Session TTL / max lifetime for automatic rotation

question: Should OpenClaw add normal-session max-age/max-turn automatic rotation, and what public config shape plus memory/continuity contract should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix defines public lifecycle config and behavior for preserving session state across automatic resets.

options.title: Add opt-in lifecycle policy
options.body: Extend session.reset with maintainer-approved max-age and max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory and continuity semantics.

options.title: Fold into broader session lifecycle design
options.body: Keep this as a requirement but implement it only as part of a unified design with session boundaries, context-pressure rollover, and pre-reset memory flushing.

options.title: Defer automatic rotation
options.body: Document cron, compaction, transcript rotation, and manual reset mitigations while avoiding new core lifecycle config for now.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in lifecycle policy
recommendation.body: Extend session.reset with maintainer-approved max-age and max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory and continuity semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history on daily reset, memory flush, and adjacent session lifecycle decisions.
